context: Sho and Hina dress up for a school event.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、今日の服装、可愛い！
lines.en: Sho, your outfit today is so cute!
lines.style: Bright, genuine compliment delivered with unguarded eight-year-old enthusiasm. Quick opening attack. Warm and admiring without trying to be cool about it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: You look beautiful too, you know.
lines.style: Soft, sincere response from a six-year-old. Quiet delivery, genuine warmth. Small voice but steady. No pretense—just honest appreciation.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Excited proposal, quick and bright. Eight-year-old energy—already moving to the next fun thing. Eager, inclusive, no hesitation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: いいね、頑張って、笑おう。
lines.en: Yeah, let's really smile for it.
lines.style: Six-year-old agreement, small but determined. Slight effort in the voice—he's taking this seriously, wants to do it right. Quiet concentration beneath the warmth.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Satisfied observation from Hina. Gentle, contented tone. The happiness of a moment well-lived. Trailing off slightly, just savoring.
